title: Chapter 579
text:
On the forums, many players and mercenaries were sharing what they had seen. The Blue Star section became the most popular area, and players from other novice planets would occasionally sneak over to take a look.

Some people complained about the various strange alien species, some took pictures of the magnificent cosmic scenery, and some took photos with famous NPCs … mainly Aroshia, Fu Ding, and Sylvia.

Han Xiao agreed to Risda's request, so he sent the scenes that Aroshia remembered to all the players and wrote a new mission. With hundreds of thousands of players searching together, the efficiency would naturally be higher.

Pork Bun and Galaxy Times followed the trend and released a new video. The content was about the first batch of galactic players, introducing the Black Star Corps and the various functions of Base No.1. At the same time, the award ceremony of the faction leader, Black Star, received a lot of attention.

Han Xiao was already a famous NPC in the eyes of the players, and his existence was once again highlighted.

There was also another hot post, which was about the changes in Blue Star.

There were still hundreds of thousands of players on Blue Star who were working hard to pass the test of Base No.2. They had witnessed the galactic financial groups helping Blue Star develop, and they had also received more mission opportunities.

Han Xiao learned from the post that with the help of the galactic financial groups, Blue Star had welcomed a technological explosion, and countless buildings had been erected. They were stepping into the galactic era at an extremely fast speed.

He was not surprised by this. When he spread the news to the galactic reporters, he already knew that there would be such an outcome.

However, in the eyes of the players, the changes in Blue Star could be summed up in one sentence:

When a man achieves the Dao, even his chickens and dogs will ascend to the heavens!

The chronicles compiled by the players clearly recorded the changes in Blue Star. The current changes were almost single-handedly driven by Han Xiao.

It was because of Black Star's influence in the universe that Blue Star was able to develop at such a fast speed.

Allowing hundreds of millions of Blue Star citizens to live in peace and prosperity. Based on this alone, Black Star was a great man of this planet.

This kind of Radiance image had extremely high personal charisma, and many Blue Star players secretly felt a sense of cohesion. Feelings had always been an inexplicable thing.

…

A few days later.

The movements of the players were roughly divided into four types.

First, stay in Base No.1 and familiarize yourself with the new main city. Then, start with the Black Star Mercenaries stationed there and trigger a mission.

Secondly, those who couldn't make up their minds would choose to stay on the bustling Planet Golden Gate and start digging for missions and events on this planet.

Thirdly, they accepted different missions. According to Philip's guidance, they took an intergalactic travel group that had preferential terms for the Black Star Corps and went to different Star Zones in the Garton Star System, doing missions while exploring the universe.

The last option was for the 200,000 players who had accepted the Sunil Rescue Mission to follow the Sunil mercenary team led by Herlous, board the Black Star Corps battleships, and head toward Planet Sunil.

The players were very active, and they were only in the early stages of entering the universe. Thus, they chose to be more cautious.

Because they were not familiar with the universe, it was very likely that they would break different laws. Thus, Han Xiao's missions were only limited to the Garton Star System for the time being. Furthermore, Philip's sub-program would remind them of the local laws and regulations at any time to minimize the chances of the players breaking the law.

However, there would always be players who liked to mess around. After all, the players did not like to be restricted, and their brains were like black holes.

Han Xiao understood the 'creativity' of the players too well. Thus, he was not blindly optimistic because of the current situation.

As the saying went, 'a person's heart is like water.' This was especially true for the players who were naturally chaotic. For this reason, Han Xiao had long prepared an emergency program that would be used sooner or later. He did not have the desire to control, but the punishment mechanism had to exist.

Of course, it was still in the early stages of smooth sailing, so he was still in the mood to evade taxes.

Most of the players left Base No.1 with curiosity and excitement, heading out to carry out missions and explore different Star Zones.

This was the first batch of missions. After a few months of the Mutation Disaster and the Dark-star incident, the business of the Black Star Corps had finally officially begun.

Han Xiao had set up a pre-purchase function for Philip's sub-program, allowing the players who were active outside to check the faction's products. It was more convenient, as they could pay in advance and pick up the goods when they returned to the base.

However, the players could also pay an additional fee to purchase a door-to-door delivery service. The fee depended on the distance, and only after a certain number of goods were accumulated would the goods be delivered together. However, if the players were willing to spend more money to purchase a private delivery service, the goods could be delivered immediately.

The cost of shipping was higher than the cost of manpower and fuel. This was a way to generate additional income. However, the players were still very poor, so this service was still in the trial stage. The details had yet to be perfected. Due to the vastness of the galaxy, the Universal Logistics industry was extremely developed. With Han Xiao's current reputation, it was not difficult for him to find a few logistics companies to cooperate with. He could even build his own logistics channel.

Building a large mercenary group was like building a corporation. Transportation, transportation, reputation, manpower, assets, benefits, business scope, and so on all had to be considered. The players were like the trump card of a corporation, containing huge benefits. They could be harvested batch after batch, bringing in endless profits. Thus, the current work was to focus on the trump card project and perfect the various aspects of the faction.

…

Herlous led the team to Sunil. Just in case, Han Xiao threw an Observer's Mark on him. This was the third mark.

Some time ago, he had tried out the racial talent of [Chaos Observer]. His vision could transcend the limits of physical distance, and his vision could lock onto the target within a certain range. He could see Aroshia eating and Serbia the Fifth being busy every day, but the target of his observation did not notice at all. It was practically a godly tool for peeping.

Base No.1 instantly became much emptier. Other than the players who stayed behind, only Aroshia and Sylvia remained in the base. The rest of them led the mercenaries to do some medium to high difficulty missions.

Han Xiao also remained in the base.

With more than 30,000,000 Enas in his account, he was as confident as a dragon. With a wave of his hand, he directly bought a large number of materials.

Money was the combat strength of the Mech Army Style. After advancing to the Calamity Grade, he would be able to build stronger machines. He planned to strengthen the foundation of the original Mech Army. Not only would he restore the previous army structure, but he would also add some new units.

Han Xiao prepared to go into seclusion to build the machines. This would take some time, and he had a few hundred thousand alloy livers under him. It was fully automated, so he had more free time to do other things.

Since Ames did not rush him, he was not in a hurry to send Hella and Aurora to Floating Dragon.

"I still owe the Noriose Financial Group four million Enas. It hasn't even been two years, and the interest is only ten percent. After two years, the interest will increase."

Han Xiao suddenly remembered this debt. He had a lot of savings now, and after weighing the pros and cons, he decided to repay this debt while the interest was not high.

He contacted the leader of the Noriose Financial Group, Rockfess, and the projection of the other party appeared before him.

"Black Star? Haha, long time no see. You've been in the limelight recently. "

Rockfess had a warm smile on his face, and his tone was warm.

Compared to the attitude he had when he had taken the loan, he was clearly trying to be friendly.

"Actually, I prefer to keep a low profile." Han Xiao coughed and said, "This time, I'm contacting you because I'm prepared to repay the four million Enas loan. Including the interest, it's a total of four million and four hundred thousand Enas."

The legal effect of loans was very strong, and he definitely had to repay the money.

Rockfess suddenly changed the topic. "I wonder if you're willing to accept a new round of funding?"

Han Xiao had just transferred the four million and four hundred thousand Enas over and was looking at the amount he had to pay. Hearing this, he raised his brows, and a playful look appeared in his eyes.

More than a year ago, he had looked for Rockfess for an investment, but Rockfess had rejected it and only agreed to take a loan. Now, the other party had taken the initiative to propose a new round of funding?

Heh, it seems like my recent achievements have made Rockfess think that I'm worth investing in. That's why he changed his attitude and took the initiative to propose this.

Although Rockfess was rather snobbish, Han Xiao did not find it strange, and he did not have any intention of mocking him. The world was filled with people for profit, and only those who had shown potential or strength would have people invest in them.

"Of course, I'm very interested in this suggestion." Han Xiao smiled.

Rockfess' eyes sparkled.

He was originally unsure of Han Xiao's intentions and was worried that Black Star would no longer need external funding. Although he would not suffer any losses, he would feel regretful that he would lose an investment channel with great potential.

It was a good thing that Black Star was willing to continue accepting investments. It meant that his initial investment had paid off.

Rockfess pondered for a moment before saying, "Your Excellency Black Star, I've decided to provide an additional 5.2 million Enas to the Black Star Corps."

"Then, what do you want in return?" Han Xiao stroked his chin.

"Haha, this is only an initial investment. I hope to reach a long-term investment agreement with the Black Star Corps. Our Noriose Financial Group will provide funds to support the development of the Black Star Corps, including but not limited to the treatment of mercenaries, transportation, business expansion, base construction, and so on. We can also borrow the name of the Black Star Corps to carry out business activities in the Garton Star System or other Star Systems that value the Black Star Corps. When we encounter a situation that requires violence, we will be able to obtain the help of the Black Star Corps immediately …"

Rockfess spoke frankly and confidently, stating the general terms and conditions for financial groups to invest in armed forces.

Logically speaking, the Black Star Corps was the Field Team of Floating Dragon, so it would be better to invest in Floating Dragon. However, Black Star himself had a certain amount of influence, so he had become another target of investment.

Han Xiao listened patiently and concluded that the Noriose Financial Group wanted to take over the logistics of the Black Star Corps.

The Noriose Financial Group had a good reputation, a good reputation, and many businesses.

It just so happened that he wanted to improve the logistics of the Black Star Corps. With the help of Noriose, he would be able to save a lot of effort … and more importantly, he would be able to save a lot of money. The cost of building an armed force was extremely high.

What a fat sheep … Han Xiaoxin sighed in his heart.

"Sounds good, Mr. Rockfess. I'm willing to sign the investment agreement."

"Okay, I'll get someone to prepare it immediately. I'll send it to you later."

Rockfess was in a good mood, and he was in high spirits.

"If the Black Star Corps continues to grow in the future, our Noriose Financial Group can even help you manage the stock market, create a brand, and issue credit bonds."

"Let's talk about this in the future …"

Han Xiao's mouth twitched.

The so-called credit bonds were actually stocks. As the economy developed, there would definitely be wise people who would come up with this idea. A long time ago, there were already stocks in Galaxy. Countless large financial groups and enterprises in the universe had issued credit bonds for the entire universe to purchase. Because the base was too large, they were split into different stock markets based on regions. For example, the Garton Star System had its own credit bond market.

The players could also purchase credit bonds, and the degree of freedom was very high. In Han Xiao's previous life, a portion of the players had made a lot of money through the credit bond market. Of course, there were even more players who had lost their underwear. With the environment in Galaxy, the volatility of the market was imaginable.

Han Xiao was very experienced in making money through credit bonds. In his previous life, he had done a lot of things like buying low and selling high. As for how to lower the price of a certain enterprise's credit bonds … Hehe, he had never taken the proper route when helping people level and increase their popularity. He had already done so many bad things, and one more did not make a difference.

Of course, the repercussions were very serious. Now that he had a family, he was not interested in repeating the same mistakes.

As for Rockfess' suggestion of letting the mercenary group go public, there were very few examples of this happening. Because the business was not stable, there would be casualties from time to time.

After signing the contract, a 'ding' sound rang on the communicator, indicating that he had received a deposit. His deposit had increased by 5.2 million Enas.

"The days ahead are still long. Let's have a pleasant cooperation." Rockfess smiled and extended his hand.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and shook Rockfess's hand.
